premises.text: Nematodes are abundant and cause significant crop loss for farmers
premises.evidence_span: farmers lose roughly 12% of their crops every year to plant parasitic nematodes

premises.text: Consumers are demanding safe and eco-friendly pest control
premises.evidence_span: consumers are demanding safe and eco-friendly pest control used on their foods

premises.text: There is a growing market for eco-friendly alternatives in pest control
premises.evidence_span: this has had a negative impact on the current $50 billion pesticide market, but a positive impact on both the biopesticide and seed treatment markets

premises.text: Pheromones can be used to control nematode behavior
premises.evidence_span: when you add the pheromones, they disperse and they look for new food

premises.text: Ferricote protects seeds from plant-parasitic nematodes
premises.evidence_span: Ferricote is a seed treatment that is applied to seeds before they are planted, and it protects the young and vulnerable roots from attack by plant-parastic nematodes

premises.text: Nemastem enhances the effectiveness of beneficial nematodes
premises.evidence_span: Nemastem makes beneficial nematodes up to 200% more effective

value.text: Farmers can achieve eco-friendly pest control to protect their crops
value.evidence_span: help us bring eco-friendly pest control

notes: Scaling technology and seeking commercial partners are excluded as traction.
